cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Ìtàn is a retrieval-grounded, tool-calling agricultural extension agent: a structured knowledge base (crop calendars, spacing, fertiliser rates, agrochemical registrations, varieties, pests) plus hybrid retrieval over African agricultural extension literature grounds every answer in a cited source, and deterministic Python tools handle all arithmetic (fertiliser dosing, seed rate, spray dilution, margins) instead of model recall. Targets extension officers and the farmers they serve, fully offline.

test_prompts.prompt: I get 0.6 hectares of maize for Kaduna, how much urea I go need and when I go apply am?
My maize leaves have ragged holes and there is sawdust-like frass packed in the whorl. What pest is this, and what registered treatment should I use?
